subject: Stage clarity & commit-readiness check — please update by EOD
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stage clarity & commit-readiness check — please update by EOD

Team —

Quick reminder ahead of the leadership review pack build: please confirm stage and commit-status for any Q4 deals you own in the attached export by EOD today (Nov 19 PST). Finance needs accurate flags for the exec pack and the QBR slide that goes to the CFO.

What I need from each owner (one-line per deal in the CSV or a reply):
- Forecast stage (e.g., Proposal, Negotiation, Legal)
- Commit? (Yes/No)
- If Commit=Yes: expected close date and primary risk (one short phrase)
- If moving out of commit: reason code (pricing, product fit, procurement, other)
- Net ARR (USD) and expected contract start date

I attached a snapshot (nov_pipeline_snapshot.csv) with current values — please update the row(s) for your deals and re-upload to the shared Drive link below or reply-all with an inline delta.

Why this matters: Markus will pull a consolidated table for the exec pack and we need to surface any pipeline movement (upgrades, push-outs, commit removals) before we finalize slides. If you have exceptions you want considered for the commit column, flag them in your reply and tag a short justification.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/exec-pack
Deadline: Today EOD PST (I will synthesize at 4:30pm PT for the draft pack)

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
(Attachment: nov_pipeline_snapshot.csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stage clarity & commit-readiness check — please update by EOD

Neha — thanks for the ping. I will do a pass on deals in my book and push updates to the CSV by 2pm PT. A couple of quick notes:
- I'll include SDR/AM notes for any deals I flip to "Not Commit" so finance understands signal.
- For two larger opportunities (ACME-Intelligence and ACME-Cloud), legal cadence is the gating factor — I will add expected legal complete dates in the close_date field.

If Markus wants, I can also surface the top three risk drivers per opportunity in a separate tab to make the exec summary cleaner.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial GTM | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: none)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stage clarity & commit-readiness check — please update by EOD

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 8:45 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Neha — thanks for the ping. I will do a pass on deals in my book and push updates to the CSV by 2pm PT.

Thanks, Laura — that's perfect. Two asks from my side before I assemble the pack at 4:30pm:
1) If you mark a deal as commit=Yes but have an outstanding PO/contract signature with the same close date, please add the "close_probability_adjusted" column as a % (finance uses this for sensitivity). If you don't have probability, default to the stage historical average.
2) Grace — can you confirm whether we should include trial ARR as part of Net ARR for the QBR slides? We had differing practices last quarter and execs prefer uniformity.

I'll incorporate any exceptions and send a consolidated exec_pack_draft.pdf for review by 5:00pm PT.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: none)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: sara.lynch@acme.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Stage clarity & commit-readiness check — synth + next steps

Folks — synth of the day and next steps (finalizing for leadership):

Summary:
- Received updated rows for 28 deals; 5 deals moved out of Commit and 3 moved to Commit after pricing discussions.
- Primary movement driver: procurement timing (3) and legal review (2).

Checklist (final actions before pack finalization):
- Laura: upload amended CSV with SDR notes by 2pm PT (done)
- Markus: incorporate "close_probability_adjusted" for commit=Yes rows (please default where unknown)
- Grace: confirm treatment of trial ARR for slides (ACTION: reply by 10am PT tomorrow)
- All: if you changed commit status, add a one-line rationale in the CSV comments column.

Attachments uploaded to Drive and attached here: exec_pack_draft.pdf (first-pass slides), nov_pipeline_snapshot.csv (final raw rows). I'm leaving the drafts in Drive under /QBR/2026Q4/Redwood-Exec-Pack.

External note: I cc'ed Sara from Acme to keep them aware of updated close dates for ACME-Intelligence and ACME-Cloud. Sara — thanks for confirming the revised legal ETA earlier today.

I'll lock the pack at 5pm PT and share the final slides. If anyone expects more than minor changes after that window please flag now so I can push to the late-change queue.

Thanks all — good close on the staging work today.

Neha
(Attachment: exec_pack_draft.pdf, nov_pipeline_snapshot.csv)
